parsed.why: Moderate-risk tier and no statewide adult bathroom ban, but statewide gender-identity nondiscrimination and hate-crime coverage are absent outside four municipalities; youth-care and sports restrictions advance via appointed boards.
Worst-state tier: birth-certificate changes effectively barred and adult bathroom use restricted in many state-run facilities; no state gender-identity nondiscrimination or hate-crime coverage.
Low-risk tier plus explicit gender-identity discrimination protections, open marker rules and a sanctuary-city care shield; offset by national passport/entry regime and no hate-crime coverage.

Low-risk tier and no adult facility or care ban, but no statewide gender-identity nondiscrimination or hate-crime coverage; restrictive birth-certificate surgery rule and national border regime remain.

Criminal bathroom law reaching private businesses, with up to a year in jail, is a state-imposed universal exposure; only litigation is pending. Materially below parent despite no reported enforcement.
